title: Follow a session while it works

captures.name: drawer
captures.title: Open a session
captures.body: Open one by its name. The conversation slides in beside the list on a desktop and over it on a phone, so you never lose your place in the fleet.

captures.name: header
captures.title: Who is running this, and where
captures.body: The top row answers the questions you ask first: is it alive, which machine is it on, which account is paying for it, and what is it called.

captures.name: timeline
captures.title: Everything it did is on the record
captures.body: Each message is badged with its kind: your prompts, the agent’s replies, its reasoning, every tool call and the result that came back. Nothing is summarised away.

captures.name: line
captures.title: Lift one message out
captures.body: Any single message can be pinned to find again, copied as Markdown for a ticket, or saved as an image to paste into a review.

captures.name: tools
captures.title: Hide the noise
captures.body: Hiding the assistant messages leaves the tool calls — the fastest way to audit what an agent touched.

captures.name: reply
captures.title: Steer it from here
captures.body: Anything you type goes to the running agent, so you can redirect it mid-task instead of stopping it and starting again.
